description:
"I'm going to build a place where young people can challenge to reach any of their dreams!"

The 7 genius students, known as the GREAT 7, launched a project to construct an artificial island called Nanae Island to realize their leader, Nanana Ryugajo's peculiar idea.

12 years later, with a total population of 100,000 people with as much as 80% of those inhabitants being students, Nanae Island has successfully become prosperous as a special student zone. One of the island's newest residents was Jugo Yama -- a high school student who had just transferred to the island after being disowned by his father. One day, Jugo finds in his own apartment the earth-bound spirit of the late Nanana Ryugajo, who was murdered by someone 10 years ago! Jugo's plan of living alone was suddenly thwarted by this strange roommate.

The original novel "Nanana's Buried Treasure" won the Grand Prize of the 13th Entertainment Awards, which was the first Grand Prize in eight years. This anime series features the adventures and challenges of Jugo Yama as he searches through the historic ruins of Nanae Island for the great treasures, A.K.A "Nanana's Collection," along with the extraordinary characters he meets along the way. The mysterious puzzles of the ruins! The excitement of the treasure hunt! The strategic maneuvers and battles of thought and reason between the characters! Nanana's Buried Treasure is an adventure you won't want to miss!

(Source: Aniplex USA)

node.description: She is a high-school student who is self proclaimed "Master Detective," for obvious reason that she has very good observation and deduction skills. However, she would also find herself in trouble with the island's police not because she is a young offender, but because of her habit of intruding in to their investigation whenever a crime happens in the island. She has an assistant named, Daruku, in which the two maintains a sort of Sherlock Holmes and John Watson kind of relationship, she and the Daruku later on transfers to Juugo's school after a brief visitation and a little bit of interrogation where she retrieve a stolen item which is part of the "Nanana's Collection" that the latter mistakenly took, she also become a member of the school's "Adventure Club."

The female heroine. Nanana is the ghost bound to Juugo's room since her murder 10 years ago. Unable to rest in peace, Nanana spends all her time playing video and online games and eating her favorite and only food, pudding. She is thus forced to live as a NEET, and although she was never bored with it, she was actually lonely until Juugo rented the room. Living as a human, Nanana was an exceptional student who was extremely adventurous, and she along with seven other exceptional high school students—known as the "Great 7"—founded the Nanae Island project.

Her collections were rumored to be a treasure trove of her enormous fortune that she amassed from her treasure hunting adventures. Part of it was used to fund her project, while the rest were hidden all over the island. Among her collections are rare and mysterious artifacts that contain magical properties.

A shinobi and a professional thief who is among those who are interested in stealing and looking for some rare artifacts that are part of "Nanana's Collection." She and Shuu form a duo called "Phantom Thief Troupe Matsuri"; however, she would often beat up Shuu for botching up the job. As a shinobi, she very capable fighter who wouldn't hesitate to take down any opponents.

(Source: ANN)

He is Tensai's assistant, where they maintain a sort of Sherlock Holmes and John Watson-like relationship. Though he may look like a girl, he is actually a cross-dressing boy. Daruku, along with Tensai, transfer into Juugo's school where they are also the his classmates after their brief visitation at the his apartment where they also met Nanana. He also becomes a member of the "Adventure Club" since he goes wherever Tensai goes.

Juugo is energetic yet obsess with girls. He is devoted to help Nanana move on, in spite of her constant commotion in his room, as he tries to find interest in her. Juugo joins the school's adventure club on a hunt for the island's Nanana Collection.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Shiki Maporo is the landlady of the apartment that Juugo currently lives in. She is Nanana's best friend from when she was still human, and they use to go on explorations on the island with the Great 7 group. She hopes Juugo could keep Nanana in need of company.

(Source: Wikipedia)
The vice president of the school's "Adventure Club" and Isshin's most loyal assistant. As a skilled fighter, she also serves as Isshin's bodyguard.

He is a lesser seen character whom Isshin contacts, however, it is suggested that he is Juugo's upperclassman and a member of the school's adventure club, it is also suggested that he also serves as Isshin's henchman.
The president of the school's Adventure Club.
Vice-president of the first generation adventure club. He serve as the main antagonist of the story.

Part of the duo of profession thieves call "Phantom Thief Troupe, Matsuri" who are in the business of stealing rare artifacts belonging to the so called "Nanana's Collection." He is called "Hundred Faces" because he is a master of disguise. He uses his skills to either deceive someone or to infiltrated any establishment that he and his partner, Yukihime, plan to target. However, he isn't very smart and most of the time, bungles up which often earns Yukihime's ire.

(Source: Anilinkz)
